Kforce has a client that is seeking a Data Analyst in Newark, DE.

Overview:
As a Data Analyst within the CAPO - Legal Entity Management team at this company, you will play a critical role in ensuring legal entity data is accurately established, maintained, and reported across firmwide systems that support Global Alternatives. Based in Newark, Delaware, you will partner with a broad range of stakeholders across the Alternatives business and internal regulatory teams, operating at the intersection of operations execution, data quality, controls, and stakeholder management. You will also contribute to special initiatives aligned to the Alternatives Data Strategy. This role is ideal for someone who takes ownership, enjoys problem-solving, and is motivated by continuous improvement-streamlining processes, reducing manual work through automation and smarter tooling, and delivering outcomes that are visible, measurable, and important to the business.
 
  Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution 
  2 or more years of relevant experience in financial services operations, with exposure to cross-functional stakeholders and business-critical workflows 
  Proficiency with modern data and automation tools such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Power BI, Power Automate, or similar technologies, with demonstrated ability to analyze data, automate processes, and reduce reliance on manual, spreadsheet-based workflows 
  Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to translate complex inputs into clear insights, actions, and high-quality outputs 
  Demonstrated problem-solving mindset, including the ability to identify root causes, propose practical process improvements, and drive changes through to implementation 
  Exceptional attention to detail and strong quality orientation, with comfort working in a controlled environment where accuracy and documentation matter 
  Clear, confident communicator (written and verbal), able to synthesize complex topics and influence outcomes across a broad range of partners 
  Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining strong execution discipline 
  Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working independently, while also thriving in a collaborative team setting
